description: This file defines a system handler for Android notifications within a Kotlin-based Android app. It manages posting notifications with support for different priorities, permissions, and notification channels, and provides an interface for handling notification requests with JSON parameters.

classes.name: SystemNotifyRequest
classes.description: Data class representing a notification request with title, body, sound, and priority.

classes.name: SystemNotificationPoster
classes.description: Interface defining methods to check authorization and post notifications.

classes.name: AndroidSystemNotificationPoster
classes.description: Implementation of SystemNotificationPoster for Android platform, handling notification permissions and posting.

classes.name: SystemHandler
classes.description: Main class responsible for handling system notifications, including parsing JSON requests and managing notification posting.

methods.name: isAuthorized
methods.description: Checks if the app has permission to post notifications.

methods.name: post
methods.description: Posts a notification based on the provided request.

methods.name: ensureChannel
methods.description: Ensures that a notification channel with appropriate importance and name exists for the given priority.

methods.name: compatPriority
methods.description: Converts a string priority to Android's notification priority constant.

methods.name: isSilentSound
methods.description: Determines if the notification sound should be silent based on the string input.

methods.name: handleSystemNotify
methods.description: Handles a system notification request received as a JSON string, validates, and posts it if authorized.

methods.name: parseNotifyRequest
methods.description: Parses a JSON string into a SystemNotifyRequest object.

methods.name: parseParamsObject
methods.description: Parses a JSON string into a JsonObject.
